data.title: String Elimination
data.solution:
INF = float('inf')

s = list(map(ord, input()))
n = len(s)
c0 = [INF] * 128
c1 = [INF] * 128
c1[s[0]] = s[0]

for i in range(1, n):
    c0[s[i]] = min(c0[s[i]], c1[s[i]])
    c1[s[i]] = c0[s[i-1]] + s[i]

if c0[s[-1]] == INF:
    print(-1)
else:
    print(sum(s) - 2*c0[s[-1]])

data.constraints:
1 ≤ |[[s]]| ≤ 10000
[[s]] only consists of ASCII characters ranging from {{' '}} to {{'~'}}.
Here, |[[s]]| means the length of string [[s]].
data.outputDescription: The maximum total cost to make [[s]] an empty string, or {{-1}} if it's impossible to make [[s]] an empty string.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You are given a string s consisting of ASCII characters ranging from ' ' to '~'. You can perform the following operation any number of times:

● Choose two indices i and j such that sᵢ = sⱼ;
● The cost of this operation is the sum of the ASCII values of all the characters between sᵢ and sⱼ, exclusive;
● Remove all the characters between sᵢ and sⱼ, inclusive.

The total cost is the sum of all the costs of all the operations you performed. Find the maximum total cost to make s an empty string. Print -1 if it's impossible to make s an empty string.
Input
A string s.
Output
The maximum total cost to make s an empty string, or -1 if it's impossible to make s an empty string.
Constraints
1 ≤ |s| ≤ 10000
s only consists of ASCII characters ranging from ' ' to '~'.
Here, |s| means the length of string s.
Example
Input
a a
Output
32
